name: Xathrid Gorgon
description: A gorgon who breaks into Sentos' cottage seeking the eyes of a righteous man for a demon.

timeline.summary: The Xathrid Gorgon attacks Sentos but he cannot die because of the ring.
timeline.quote: He was surprised by a Xathrid Gorgon pressing a knife to his throat.

citation.text: "Sentos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The gorgon cuts the ring from Sentos' finger, ending his immunity; Sentos petrifies her with his gaze as he dies.
timeline.quote: Sentos turned over and stared into the gorgon's eyes, petrifying him immediately
